At Paul Hastings since 1972 (Of Counsel since ~1992). Partner at Fisher Brothers. Currently holds 7+ simultaneous board/advisory roles: G42 General Counsel, MGX Board Director, GlobalFoundries Board (Mubadala designee since Feb 2017), City Football Group/Manchester City Board (since Sept 2008), Equity Commonwealth Board, Aldar REIT Director, MBZUAI Board of Trustees, Royal Group Adviser, Mubadala Senior Adviser, Sky News Arabia Editorial Advisory Committee. Previously: AMD Board (2013-2017, Mubadala designee), Avis Board Chairman (1998-1999), Capital Trust Director, Ashford Hospitality Trust Director, AGT International Chairman.

findings.summary: Edelman's Abu Dhabi connection originated in 2002 during a Gulf tour with U.S. General Tommy Franks (CENTCOM commander for Afghanistan/Iraq). Franks visited Arab leaders monthly and Edelman accompanied him on some trips. Through this military-facilitated introduction, Edelman built relationships with Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed (MBZ) and his brother Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed. He initially also worked in Libya with Gaddafi's son but shifted to Abu Dhabi after Libya's instability. He was reportedly granted Emirati citizenship -- extremely rare for a foreign national.

CRITICAL EPSTEIN CONNECTION: Jeffrey Epstein emailed 'Jabor Y.' on June 24, 2017 with subject line 'legal advice for MBZ' containing a link to Edelman's AMD board appointment press release. This email directly connects Epstein to the Abu Dhabi royal circle through Edelman. 'MBZ' = Mohammed bin Zayed (UAE President). 'Jabor Y.' likely Jabor bin Yousuf Al Serkal or similar UAE figure. The email was sent from jeevacation@gmail.com (Epstein's personal account). This suggests Epstein was either (a) recommending Edelman as legal counsel to Abu Dhabi figures, or (b) discussing Edelman's role in Abu Dhabi governance as insider information.

findings.summary: Martin Edelman appeared on Epstein's calendar for December 16, 2016 as 'TBD Martin Edelman' -- the same day Epstein had a 10am appointment with Leon Black. Email chain from Dec 8, 2016 shows Lesley Groff (Epstein's assistant) initially contacted Martin Nowak (Harvard scientist) about the meeting, confusing 'Martin Edelman' with 'Jerry Edelman' (Nobel scientist Gerald Edelman). Nowak replied 'could it be someone else (not me)?' and Groff realized 'perhaps the person full name IS Martin Edelman\!\!' This confirms the calendar entry refers to Martin L. Edelman the lawyer, not any scientist, and that Epstein was meeting with Abu Dhabi's key legal intermediary.

Martin Edelman appears on Epstein's master contact lists (Oct 30 and Nov 1, 2016). The lists were sent by Epstein to himself and contain names organized by category. 'Edelman' appears first in the list, followed by 'set martin, Lata, susskind, strominger...' mixing scientists with political/financial contacts ('kerry, clinton, richardosn, mapp, leahy, spitzer, shcumer'). A later version (June 30, 2019) titled 'list for bannon steve' includes 'pritzker edelman. set lloyd, martin novak' alongside 'raafat, sultan hamad jabor' (Gulf contacts). Edelman's inclusion alongside Gulf contacts and Steve Bannon suggests Epstein viewed him as a political/Gulf access point.

Edelman was the key intermediary who connected Ari Emanuel (WME/Endeavor) to Abu Dhabi royals, leading to Sheikh Tahnoon's ~USD 200M investment in UFC. Per New Yorker profile of Emanuel: 'Emanuel called a New York real-estate lawyer named Martin Edelman, whom he had met through representing the UFC. Edelman was a longtime adviser to the Fertitta brothers. More important, he was close to the royal family of the Emirates.' Edelman introduced Emanuel to Khaldoon Al Mubarak. A year later, Tahnoon made a handshake deal with Lorenzo Fertitta for 10% of UFC.

findings.summary: Edelman has a longstanding personal friendship with Donald Trump dating to the 1980s NYC real estate era. Bloomberg (May 2025) described Edelman as holding 'strong ties with figures across the spectrum -- from the Kennedy family and George Soros to a longstanding friendship with Donald Trump, dating back to their 1980s real estate days.' Edelman helped organize Trump's May 2025 visit to Abu Dhabi where U.S.-UAE signed strategic AI partnership including a 5-gigawatt computing and energy hub. This dual relationship with both Trump and Tahnoon makes Edelman uniquely positioned as kingmaker in U.S.-UAE deals.

Edelman has SEC CIK 0001047252 with 212+ insider transaction filings, primarily Form 4s related to GlobalFoundries (GFS) stock. His SEC filings confirm he is classified as a reporting insider for GlobalFoundries. The filings span from at least 2020 to 2023, with Form 144 (intent to sell) filings in December 2023. His FEC political donations from Paul Hastings are limited: two donations totaling USD 5,000 to Chris Coons (D-DE) in July 2025. National Law Journal named him one of 34 most influential lawyers in the U.S. in 2011. He received the Department of the Army Public Service Award in 2007.

CONFLICT OF INTEREST ANALYSIS: Edelman simultaneously serves as (1) G42 General Counsel representing Tahnoon's interests, (2) MGX Board Director (Tahnoon's AI investment fund), (3) WLFI Board Member (undisclosed -- placed alongside Peng Xiao without public announcement), (4) adviser to Royal Group (Tahnoon's personal conglomerate), (5) Mubadala Senior Adviser, (6) GlobalFoundries Board member (Mubadala designee for company that manufactures semiconductors), (7) Paul Hastings Of Counsel (attorney-client privilege concerns). He signed the Aryam-WLFI agreement acquiring 49% of Trump's crypto venture. Congress (Rep. Ro Khanna) launched probe Feb 5, 2026 into whether the WLFI investment influenced U.S. AI chip export controls. Edelman straddles both sides of the chip-for-investment quid pro quo under investigation.

Edelman facilitated the 2008 Abu Dhabi acquisition of Manchester City FC and was appointed to the board in September 2008. He is Executive Chairman of Manchester Life (Abu Dhabi joint venture real estate in Manchester) and Vice Chairman of New York City FC. He was also instrumental in establishing NYU Abu Dhabi. He later facilitated Tahnoon's investment in UFC via Ari Emanuel. Pattern: Edelman consistently serves as the gateway for Abu Dhabi sovereign capital entering Western markets -- sports (Manchester City, NYCFC, UFC), education (NYU Abu Dhabi, MBZUAI), technology (AMD, GlobalFoundries, G42, MGX), media (Sky News Arabia), real estate (Aldar, Manchester Life), and now crypto/politics (WLFI).

findings.summary: Edelman's relationship with Epstein raises critical questions about the Abu Dhabi-Epstein nexus. The June 24, 2017 email from Epstein to 'Jabor Y.' with subject 'legal advice for MBZ' referencing Edelman came AFTER Epstein's 2008 conviction and during the period when Epstein was rebuilding his network. The Dec 2016 calendar meeting places Edelman in Epstein's orbit alongside Leon Black, whose USD 158M payments to Epstein are documented. Key question: Was Epstein attempting to insert himself into Abu Dhabi's power structure through Edelman, or was there already an existing channel? The 'Jabor' recipient and 'MBZ' subject line suggest Epstein had direct Gulf contacts independent of Edelman.

SYNTHESIS: Martin Edelman is the single most important bridge node in Thread 8, connecting Epstein network, Abu Dhabi sovereign apparatus, and Trump family simultaneously. (1) Epstein connection: appeared on Dec 16 2016 Epstein calendar same day as Leon Black; on 'list for bannon steve'; subject of 'legal advice for MBZ' email (EFTA02645374). (2) Abu Dhabi: GC of G42, MGX board, Royal Group adviser, Mubadala adviser, GlobalFoundries board — entered via Gen Tommy Franks 2002 military tour. (3) Trump: personal friendship since 1980s NYC real estate. (4) WLFI: signed the USD 500M Aryam-WLFI agreement alongside Peng Xiao. He is the only person who simultaneously has documented connections to Epstein, Tahnoon, and Trump while serving as signatory on the WLFI deal.

Martin Edelman signed the Aryam Investment 1 WLFI agreement as G42 General Counsel. He and Peng Xiao (G42 CEO) received 2 of 5 board seats on WLFI. Edelman is Of Counsel at Paul Hastings LLP, adviser to Royal Group and Mubadala, board member of GlobalFoundries, MGX, MBZUAI, City Football Group (Manchester City), and Aldar REIT. He has been cultivating UAE relationships since 2002 and is a key bridge between Tahnoon's business empire and US institutions.

Martin Edelman interlocking roles: G42 General Counsel and board member; MGX board member; Royal Group adviser; Mubadala adviser; WLFI board member (Aryam nominee); GlobalFoundries board member; Paul Hastings lawyer. Also boards of Aldar REIT, City Football Group, Equity Commonwealth. He is the critical link between Tahnoon's UAE entities and Trump-family ventures. Described as prominent NY real-estate lawyer who cultivated deep UAE ties for decades.

INSTITUTIONAL CONTINUITY THESIS: The Abu Dhabi sovereign infrastructure Epstein sought to penetrate in 2017 is the same infrastructure funding Trump family ventures in 2025. Chain: Epstein recommended Edelman as legal advice for MBZ via Jabor Al Thani (EFTA02645374, Jun 2017). Edelman cultivated 12+ Abu Dhabi positions (G42 GC, MGX board, Royal Group adviser). Edelman signed 500M Aryam-WLFI deal alongside Peng Xiao (Jan 2025), now holds WLFI board seat. Same institutions (G42, Royal Group, Mubadala), same intermediary, different decade. Epstein also pitched MBZ on digital currency via Stern (EFTA02589631). Does not prove Epstein caused current deals but demonstrates infrastructure continuity.
